# TASK-174 — specification

## Scope

Motion and feel after the apple-design skill (Apple's fluid-interface talks for the web): press feedback on pointer-down; one set of critically damped springs (`web/motion.ts`; bounce only after momentum) for conversation cards, the live document, chart bars and walkthrough steps (which now move in the direction of travel); dialogs that fade and scale in and leave along the same path (separate exit keyframes, so Radix waits); a rubber-band splitter that springs back with its release velocity; a translucent top bar with reduced-transparency and more-contrast fallbacks; size-aware heading tracking with optical sizing; a short colour fade when light and dark change. Reduced motion stays instant; browser journeys run with reduced motion.
